primary_question: Within the same hospital, do people born closer in time have more similar measured personality than locally comparable people born farther apart?

included_feature_families.definition: Elapsed minutes between recorded births in the same site; outcome is prespecified validated personality-profile distance. Include site, date/cohort, local clock time and recruitment controls, with cluster-aware person/site/date inference.

excluded_feature_families.reason: Adjusted planetary dominance has no audited scoring dictionary, biography coding or independent-cohort lineage; semantic leakage remains possible.
Southern-hemisphere inversion is abstract-only and cannot separate hemisphere, latitude, culture, sampling and coding; no transform is implemented.
Violence aspects are abstract-only, multiply tested, stigmatizing and prohibited for person-level inference.
Clinical reader judgments have no deterministic rule, reader/subset confounding and low shared-chart reliability; prohibited for person-level inference.
Large nulls, flexible definitions or invalid outcome attribution; no main-effect columns or narrative tie breakers.

exploratory_only_feature_families.definition: D1 OR D9 AtmaKaraka-PutraKaraka kendra under Lahiri and mean nodes; D1-only and D9-only are correlated ablations, not corroborations; exact degree ties unresolved/excluded.
exploratory_only_feature_families.reason: One selected 84-person cohort; 60/84 versus 3025/5460 permuted is not independent replication; follower regressions reuse the same people and are secondary. Broad Vedic aggregate null is context, not an exact-rule refutation.

exploratory_only_feature_families.domain: only the original outcome after full-text recovery
exploratory_only_feature_families.reason: Applying allowance of 1 or 2 degrees is abstract-only; two variants are a corrected exploratory family, not a fitted orb or confirmed personality moderator.
Sector geometry, eligibility and controls are disputed; no sector/planet/profession pair chosen by existing sample performance. Reanalyses count as the same data.
Generic aspect tests are null and no auditable trait mapping is sufficiently supported. Secondary interaction template is reserved but no instantiated mapping enters v1.

exact_moderator_interaction_terms.conditions: Requires a separately versioned, outcome-blind manifest with exact body pair, angle, trait, frame, orb, birth-time precision, direction and calculation code before outcomes. No generic aspect main effect, three-way interaction, selected threshold, or flexible 1/2-degree choice in v1. All three terms share one secondary multiplicity family.

weighting_policy.development_learning: None in v1; any future coefficients start at zero and use shrinkage and nested development-only selection, then freeze in a new version before an untouched cohort.
weighting_policy.primary_time_distance_coefficient: Estimated in development only, direction fixed to greater similarity at smaller intervals; no coefficient transferred from historical reports.

dependency_and_corroboration.unit: independent people/cohorts rather than papers, feature rows, p-values or overlapping pairs
dependency_and_corroboration.cap: One evidence unit per unique cohort across reanalyses, republished articles, subgroup models and alternative outcomes; unknown lineage earns no additional corroboration.
dependency_and_corroboration.specific: Startup's four analyses are one N=911 cohort; Oshop follower models are one N=84 cohort; Gauquelin/CSICOP/CFEPP publication and reanalysis chains each count by actual nonoverlapping civil records; claimed abstract replications do not count until identities and methods are audited.
dependency_and_corroboration.pair_dependence: Cluster or graph-aware inference prevents repeated use of one participant from inflating sample size.

unresolved_conflicts.resolution: Reconstruct exact rule and tie behavior from original, audit selection and independently replicate on a prespecified prominence frame; no personality transport.
Obtain original four applications, aspect/outcome definitions, control and multiplicity details, and verify independent results; broader Startup null does not directly test asymmetry.
Recover full scoring and semantic pipeline, blind biography coding and complete dataset lineage; repeat end-to-end permutation and independent replication including random-keyword control.
Recover original transform and coded traits, then predefine hemisphere-by-transform analysis with latitude/culture-matched cohorts; Lu Sun-sign null is contextual rather than an exact inversion test.
Obtain full text, deduplicate case records, audit eight-test correction, orbs, birth precision and control births; still excluded from person-level use.

Choose a named original sector/profession protocol without looking at its favorable subsets; audit admission and civil records; replicate with independent matched records. Historic conflicting selection explanations remain unresolved.

Supply an independently justified exact aspect-to-trait manifest before any participant outcome is opened, then preregister continuous-orb and angularity secondary interactions; do not pool vocational or medical reports into personality evidence.
Reader-balanced shared-chart replication, reliable judgments and deterministic rule would be needed even for methodological research; clinical deployment remains excluded.

validation_boundary: All literature, past cases and owner-known outcomes are development evidence only. No owner-specific fit. Historical nulls must be reported. Untouched prospective replication is mandatory.
